name: com.datasakura.custom-navigation
description: Physics-free navigation for Unity built on DotRecast. Offline (editor) navmesh baking, a deterministic binary artifact shared by client and server, a budgeted local query scheduler, and an optional authoritative HTTP navigation server. Does not use Unity Physics or the built-in NavMesh.

samples.description: Bot agent, waypoint routes, demo presentation helpers and editor scene builders that generate the local / server / hybrid / multi-level demo scenes.
